baslik: 📘 SEXYKO GAME GUIDE (SHORT) | 24 Systems at a Glance, Details in the Guide | HYPER 16.10 BETA 🔥

metin.SAĞ TIK DEVRİ — NPC'YE GİTMEYE SON: THE RIGHT-CLICK ERA — NO MORE RUNNING TO NPCS
metin.Sol üstteki **📖 kitap** → oyunun içinde: The **📖 book** at the top left → the guide inside the game: **305 monsters**, **998 quests**, upgrade rates, drop search.
metin.**F10** ayarlar · **K** skill · **U** ka: **F10** settings · **K** skills · **U** character · **H** commands · **I** inventory · **Ctrl + D** drop source.
metin.**Level 83** · **1.000.000.000 coin** ·: **Level 83** · **1,000,000,000 coins** · 3-day EXP Premium, Valkyrie Set, Pathos, Wings, Magic Bag, War Tattoo · **24-hour Genie**.
metin.**8 Attack + 8 Buff + 8 Party** skill sl: **8 Attack + 8 Buff + 8 Party** skill slots · HP/MP by percentage · hits only the monsters on the list.
metin.Grafik, efekt, **loot filtresi**, font v: Graphics, effects, **loot filter**, font and **2nd password** — 11 tabs.
metin.**K** → **4 ayrı Quick Slot** — PK, farm: **K** → **4 separate Quick Slots** — switch quickly between PK, farm, party and event setups.
metin.Party üyelerinin **HP · MP · Buff · Dama: Turn party members' **HP · MP · Buff · Damage** info on / off separately.
metin.KC, Gem, Fragment, Chest: **sağ tıkla kı: KC, Gem, Fragment, Chest: **right-click to exchange** · Tag Name, Make Over, Nick and Job Changer are right-click too.
metin.Clana girmeden pelerin: **15 gün · 250 H: A cape without joining a clan: **15 days · 250 HP · 250 MP · 25 DEF · 3% AP** · football club capes.
metin.Neyi kırdırırsan **ne çıkar, yüzde kaç**: Whatever you exchange — **what comes out and at what percentage** — it's all in the guide.
metin.Moba tıkla → **drop yüzdeleri** · item ü: Click a monster → **drop percentages** · **Ctrl + D** on an item → which monster drops it.
metin.**[Teleport] Portal** → mobu seç → **250: **[Teleport] Portal** → choose the monster → teleport to its spot for **250,000 coins**.
metin.Sol üst **⏱** → farm süresi, **saatlik c: Top left **⏱** → farm time, **coins per hour** and **items per hour** — compare how efficient spots are.
metin.Auto Mining ürünleri **Mining Inn**'de b: Auto Mining products pile up in the **Mining Inn** · the storage is one-way: withdraw only.
metin.**Basket** ile toplu alışveriş · sponsor: Bulk shopping with the **Basket** · up to **30% off** with a sponsor streamer code.
metin.**350 KC** ile çevir ya da **2 saat onli: Spin for **350 KC**, or stay **online for 2 hours** for **1 free** spin.
metin.Sol alt **Daily Quest** → görev seç → **: Bottom left **Daily Quest** → choose a quest → **Accept** → finish before time runs out, reward comes automatically.
metin.Sağ üst **kum saati** → takvim · **Bildi: Top right **hourglass** → calendar · **Set notification** → a warning 5 minutes before the event.
metin.Knight Chaos, Border Defense War, Juraid: Knight Chaos, Border Defense War, Juraid, Forgotten Temple, Castle Siege, Knight Royale, Under the Castle — rules and rewards.
metin.**5 bölüm** · günde **3 giriş** · sıfırl: **5 stages** · **3 entries** a day · reset at **18:00** · monthly ranking.
metin.Oranlar rehberde ve **Anvil'de canlı** ·: Rates in the guide and **live on the Anvil** · highest **+8** · **Trina's Piece** raises the rate.
metin.**83 Lv + %100 EXP + 100.000.000 coin +: **Lv 83 + 100% EXP + 100,000,000 coins + 10,000 NP** → Rebirth · every level **+2 stats**.
metin.Karaktere **sağ tık → Equipment View**:: **Right-click a character → Equipment View**: equipment, upgrades, stats, resistances, buff list.
metin.24 başlık, kısa kısa — detay için başlığ: 24 topics in short — click the link under each title for details.
metin.Party Settings — HP · MP · Buff · Damage: Party Settings — HP · MP · Buff · Damage
metin.KC itemine sağ tık → direkt kırdır: Right-click the KC item → exchange it directly
